overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 (engine labels the Jan-2026 year 2026) in EDGAR companyfacts under every candidate tag the engine reads, because Snap-on reports capex only under PaymentsForCapitalImprovements. The engine applies this single FY2025 filing value to every missing period; against the same statement's true per-year values it understates FY2023 capex by $19.0M (true $95.0M) and FY2024 by $7.5M (true $83.5M), raising those years' OE by ~1.9% / ~0.7% — disclosed, not hidden; the binding base is the TTM base (STALE_FY), where the same value sits only $1.7M below the true filed-leg TTM capex of $77.7M (FY2025 $76.0M − H1 2025 $42.6M + H1 2026 $44.3M, 10-Qs under the same tag), ~0.2% of TTM OE.
